notes:
Calls keep going while you use your chats: tap the green bar to return. Video calls shrink to a small window, and you can share your screen.
Message popups with Reply, Mark as read and Mute; Answer and Decline right on incoming calls; missed calls say voice or video, and calls show inside the chat.
Status: full-screen text with your own colour and font, emoji in captions, and quick emoji replies that appear as a card in the chat.
